ai.description: Set AI_API_KEY as a GitHub Actions Secret (or local env var). Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works — override api_url for other providers. If unset, the pipeline collects and queues source items without generating articles.

publication_policy.description: Publication mode: 'auto' publishes validated articles automatically; 'review' holds all AI-generated drafts in the review queue for human approval. Sensitive topics (casualties, disputed battlefield claims, breaking allegations) always go to review regardless of mode.

schedule.description: GitHub Actions cron (every 3 hours, UTC). Change in .github/workflows/scheduled-news.yml. GitHub may delay scheduled runs; exact timing is not guaranteed.
